csv_project_name: Consulting Services for High Point Pedestrian and Bike Plan
csv_scope_of_work: The City of High Point is located in the middle of the Piedmont Triad in North Carolina. As the city continues to grow, it is committed to developing a robust multimodal network to help the city achieve its mission of creating the single most livable, safe and prosperous community in America . The HPMPO PL-104 will fund 80% of the Comprehensive Pedestrian and Bicycle Plan, which is listed in the HPMPO s FY2026-2027 Unified Planning Work Program
csv_disciplines_requested: Landscape Architecture, Civil Engineering, Surveying/GIS/Mapping, Construction/Project Management, Feasibility Studies, Land Use Planning, Planning/Master Planning, Redevelopment Planning, Hazardous Waste Engineering, Transportation Planning, Urban Studies/Planning/Design

services: Planning and consulting services including landscape architecture, civil engineering, surveying/GIS/mapping, construction/project management, feasibility studies, land use planning, planning/master planning, redevelopment planning, hazardous waste engineering, transportation planning, and urban studies/planning/design.
relevance_explanation:
- This is a citywide pedestrian and bicycle plan, not a specific bridge or structural project.
- The scope is primarily urban/transportation planning and master planning.
- No structural design, bridge engineering, long-span roof, or special structure component is identified.
- The sbp guidance explicitly excludes pure urban/open space planning, landscape, and urban design.
construction_cost_explanation: No construction budget is stated. The notice concerns planning services for a comprehensive pedestrian and bicycle plan, not a defined construction project.
